_about: Martin's personal data. Research jobs must never edit this file (see CLAUDE.md, Data schema).

ogn_watch._about: Club ships whose OGN (Open Glider Network) tracks collector/ogn_tracks.py saves every day. Addresses are from the OGN device database (https://ddb.glidernet.org/download/), device_type F = FLARM, O = OGN tracker, I = ICAO address. 'last_seen' is the last day FlightBook logged a flight at Sterling (checked 2026-09-24). David (GBSC) said on 2026-09-24 that only K1 and the ASW 19 have working trackers; the others are listed so their flights are kept if a tracker comes back.

my_flights._about: Planned: which of the saved tracks are Martin's own (date, file, notes). Not used by any script yet.
